title: Great private Gaudi tour
text:
Took the private tour with Leo. A great way to see the city and we covered far more ground than we would have done on foot. Leo tailored the tour to things we wanted to see and added a couple of extra stops including the Olympic Marina. 

The city has an excellent network of cycle lanes, so very little on road riding required.
author: Ian_P
